spans.s: DG0379 उष्ण uṣṇa heat/hotness; one of the 20 gurvadi gunas; caused due to activated agni mahābhūta; denotes physiological & pharmacological hotness; manifested by increased agni, improved appetite & digestion, increased motion in channels, pacifies vata, kapha, increases pitta. An attribute of Pitta.
AT0344 उष्णवर्ज्यो विधिः uṣṇavarjyo vidhiḥ Treatment without heat generating property.
AF2370 उष्णासह uṣṇāsaha Intolerance to heat
RS0244 उष्णोदक uṣṇodaka water is boiled & reduced to 1/8th or 1/4th or 1/2th of the quantity after boiling

SV0295 उष्ण्माश्नियात् uṣṇmāśniyāt Hot food treatment- indicated for those who suffer from diseases of kapha, & vata , who have purgation’s, who are in oleation therapy & who's body is free from moisture should be treated with hot foods.
SV0293 ऊष्णं अश्नीयात ūṣṇaṁ aśnīyāta Eating warm food – it taste well the eaten food stimulates the digestive fire.
SV0294 ऊष्णीष धारण ūṣṇīṣa dhāraṇa Wearing head wear- wearing ușnīșa bestows complex, is good for hairs, and prevents dust& wind.
